# HEIC regression fixture — provenance and license

The binary fixture `heic-8bit-512.heic` is the unmodified `testdata/test8.heic`
from [gen2brain/heic](https://github.com/gen2brain/heic/blob/main/testdata/test8.heic)
(Git blob `8d75a19cd876581310bce1d75230d4b5e00c53c9`, 22,679 bytes).
It contains genuine HEVC-coded 8-bit HEIC image pixels (512 × 512);
unlike synthetic JPEG-in-LIVP helpers or truncated HEIC headers, it
tests actual decoding and thumbnail transport. No user media is included.
